I am currently pursuing a Master of Business in Data Analytics at Monash University. 

I hold a bachelor’s degree in Language and Creative Writing from National Taipei University of Education and previously worked as a Social Marketing Specialist. My academic and professional background has led me to develop a strong interest in the intersection of creativity, communication, and data analysis. 

In particular, I am interested in how analytical methods and algorithms can be used to better understand creative content and audience behaviour, and how these insights can support more effective and evidence-based approaches to social media marketing.
